zh: 轉數快將於11月29日維護
系統維護時間為凌晨1時至11時
期間轉數快服務將暫停10小時
work.en: Hong Kong’s Faster Payment System (FPS) will be temporarily unavailable for 10 hours on 29 November 2026 due to a planned system enhancement. Hong Kong Interbank Clearing Limited will carry out the maintenance work from 1am to 11am on Sunday.
work.title: Faster Payment System to Go Offline for 10 Hours on 29 November

zh: 平安數字銀行獲母公司注資
陸金所控股增資五億港元
資金將用於充實資本及拓展業務
work.en: Ping An Digital Bank has received a further HK$500 million capital injection from its parent company, Lufax Holding. The bank stated that the additional funds will bolster its capital base, support business growth, and strengthen its role within the Ping An Group ecosystem.
work.title: Ping An Digital Bank Gets Further HK$500 Million Funding from Parent Firm

zh: 螞蟻銀行推出「螞上有息」功能
客戶贖回基金期間可繼續賺息

work.en: Ant Bank Hong Kong has introduced a new feature called 'Earn Interest on the Go'. The functionality enables users to continue earning interest on their funds during the redemption period of mutual funds or while waiting for stock sale settlements.
work.title: 螞蟻銀行推「螞上有息」功能 贖回基金或賣股期間有息收
